title: Chicago audiences compared to New Orleans
summary: Punch says Chicago liked blues at first and later classic music.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: I see. Did they have the same kind of dancing in Chicago they used to have down here? When I first went there, yeah, they was doing the same thing. Same thing.

But one thing I will say, I don't know, the Chicago people when I first got there, they liked it more blues numbers like. Because Duke Ellyn was playing nice sweet stuff and things and they kidded him. But when Louis went there with all that jumping and clowning and all kind of felt like me, you know, and the other people went for that, crazy about that. But later on they got to going for that nice music, you know. Later on, yeah, they got to going for that classic stuff. Later on.
